description: OpenCode V2 plugin that puts per-turn and per-session cost back in the TUI and OpenCode Desktop — charged cost, list-price estimates, tokens, prompt-cache reuse, latency and local history in a live line, sidebar, header badge and /usage panel.

detail.description_zh: OpenCode V2 插件，将每回合和每会话的费用重新显示在 TUI 中——包括已收费的费用、标价估算、令牌、提示缓存重用、延迟和本地历史记录，显示在实时行、侧边栏和 /usage 面板中。
